name: notifications-01
title: Notifications 01
description: An Inbox sheet on the Inbox component — rail row and bell triggers with the unread count, Mark all read and ⋯, All | Unread chips, day groups of linked rows with avatars, unread tint and action chips, and Load older.

meta.whenToUse: Your app's notification inbox, opened from the shell — copy it once and wire the rows, Mark all read and paging to your API.
meta.whenNotToUse: A single transient message — use a toast; an activity history on a record — use Timeline.
